definitions.explanation: A flowering plant with layered petals, deeply significant in Japanese culture. It is the symbol of the Imperial family and appears on the Japanese passport.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{菊|きく}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Chrysanthemums are blooming in the garden.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{菊|きく}の{花|はな}が{見頃|みごろ}を{迎|むか}える。
examples.english: Chrysanthemums reach their peak bloom in autumn.

examples.japanese: {仏壇|ぶつだん}に{白|しろ}い{菊|きく}の{花|はな}を{供|そな}えた。
examples.english: I placed white chrysanthemums at the Buddhist altar as an offering.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The chrysanthemum holds special significance in Japan. The sixteen-petal chrysanthemum ({菊花紋章|きっかもんしょう}) is the crest of the Imperial family. {菊|きく} is also associated with autumn, longevity, and nobility. White chrysanthemums are commonly used as funeral flowers and offerings at altars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菊|きく}の{花|はな} (chrysanthemum flower)
- {菊人形|きくにんぎょう} (chrysanthemum doll display)
- {菊|きく}{花展|かてん} (chrysanthemum exhibition)
- {食用菊|しょくようぎく} (edible chrysanthemum)
